title: Raspberry Crumble
description: Raspberry Crumble is a baseline modpack template for Minecraft version 1.21.1.
body:
Raspberry Crumble is a baseline modpack template for Minecraft version 1.21.1. I originally created it for personal use, but if you happen to come across it and find the included mods interesting, I’d love to hear your feedback—especially if anything feels off from the vanilla experience!

The performance mods in this pack are finely tuned with custom configuration settings that you won’t usually find in public releases. These tweaks are based on years of experience and insights gained from participating in Discord communities where mods like Sodium and Iris were developed.
